OPERATIVE REPORT

Diagnosis: Severe native aortic valve stenosis with moderate aortic regurgitation.
Procedure: Sternotomy, aortic valve replacement with bioprosthesis.

A standard median sternotomy was performed and the patient was placed on cardiopulmonary
bypass. The native valve was tricuspid, heavily calcified, and was excised in the usual
fashion. After annular sizing, a 21-mm Trifecta valve was selected for implantation given
favorable annular dimensions and was seated in standard fashion using pledgeted sutures.

Valve Type Used: Trifecta
Implant Size: 21

Following de-airing and separation from bypass, intraoperative transesophageal
echocardiography demonstrated the mean gradient is 9 mm Hg with trivial paravalvular leak.
The dimensionless valve index is 0.45. The patient tolerated the procedure well.
